mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic and sympathomimetic properties; atomoxetine is a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor and tolterodine is an antimuscarinic, both increasing noradrenergic activity and anticholinergic effects with potential additive CNS and cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia) and blood pressure elevation; dose adjustment may be needed if adverse effects emerge.
